from typing import List, Protocol, runtime_checkable

@runtime_checkable
class SupportsVectorAdd(Protocol):
    def __add__(self, other: 'SupportsVectorAdd') -> 'SupportsVectorAdd': ...
    def __sub__(self, other: 'SupportsVectorAdd') -> 'SupportsVectorAdd': ...
    def __mul__(self, scalar: float) -> 'SupportsVectorAdd': ...
    def __rmul__(self, scalar: float) -> 'SupportsVectorAdd': ...

Vector = List[float]

Matrix = List[List[float]]
